description: Resolve a latitude/longitude to the country and admin subdivisions that contain it (down to ADM5, each with its geonameId and ISO 3166-2 code where one exists), or the ocean or sea when the point is offshore, plus the nearest populated places with distances; these include neighborhood sections (PPLX) and historical places (PPLH), marked by featureCode. Set featureClasses or featureCodes to list the nearest features of that type instead (peaks, lakes, airports), cities to keep only places above a population tier, and includeTimezone for the IANA timezone with local time, sunrise, and sunset (offshore points get only GeoNames' UTC-offset estimate). A harbor, pier, or shoreline point can fall just outside every country outline and resolve to the sea; coastalBufferKm (up to 50) matches the nearest country within that distance instead. Costs 1 GeoNames credit for containment, with or without the buffer, plus 3 for nearest populated places or 4 for nearest features (nearbyLimit 0 skips them), 1 for the ocean when no country contains the point or lies within the buffer, and 1 for the timezone.

cities.description: Keep only nearby populated places with a population of at least 1,000 (cities1000), 5,000 (cities5000), or 15,000 (cities15000), plus seats of admin divisions: GeoNames' cities tiers. Not combinable with featureClasses or featureCodes.

coastalBufferKm.description: When no country contains the point, match the nearest country within this many kilometres, 0 to 50. Default 0: exact containment only. Set it for a harbor, pier, or shoreline point, which can fall just outside a country's outline as GeoNames maps it and otherwise resolves to the sea; a match carries country.distanceInKm. The nearby and timezone lookups keep the exact point. No extra credit.

featureClasses.description: List the nearest features of these GeoNames classes instead of populated places: A admin divisions, H water, L areas, P populated places, R roads, S spots and buildings, T terrain, U undersea, V vegetation. A list or a comma-separated string; case-insensitive. With featureCodes too, the two lists intersect: list exactly the classes of those codes, or pass featureCodes alone. Not combinable with cities.

featureCodes.description: List the nearest features with these GeoNames codes instead of populated places (MT mountain, PK peak, LK lake, AIRP airport), up to 20, as a list or a comma-separated string. Case-insensitive; a class prefix (T.MT) is dropped. Each code implies its class; with featureClasses too, the two lists intersect, so featureClasses must list exactly these codes' classes. geonames_list_reference topic feature_codes lists every code. Not combinable with cities.

items.description: GeoNames feature code without its class prefix.

geonamesUsername.description: Your own GeoNames username, so the call spends that account's free credits instead of the server's. Omit it to use the server's account. The account needs free web services enabled on its geonames.org account page.

includeTimezone.description: Also return the timezone: IANA id, UTC offsets, local time, sunrise, and sunset (1 more credit). Default false.

nearbyLimit.description: How many nearest places or features to list, 0 to 50. Default 5. 0 skips the nearby lookup and its 3 or 4 credits.

radiusKm.description: Radius in kilometres for the nearby lookup, above 0 and at most 300 (GeoNames' free-tier limit). Default 20.

name: geonames_reverse_geocode

adminLevels.description: Admin divisions containing the point, first level first; for a country matched within coastalBufferKm, the divisions of its part nearest the point. Empty offshore, and where GeoNames records no subdivision of the country.

items.description: One admin division containing the point, or for a country matched within coastalBufferKm, the one nearest it.

geonameId.description: GeoNames feature id of the division: pass it to geonames_get_place.

isoCode.description: ISO 3166-2 code of the division, subdivision part only (IDF, not FR-IDF), where one exists.

level.description: Admin level: 1 for the first-order division, up to 5.

country.description: The country containing the point, or with coastalBufferKm the nearest country within that distance (then distanceInKm is set); absent offshore and in unmapped areas.

countryName.description: Country name. Absent when GeoNames sent none.

distanceInKm.description: Kilometres from the point to this country as GeoNames maps it, to the metre. Present only when no country contains the point and this one was matched within coastalBufferKm.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_feature_code`: A featureCodes entry is not a GeoNames feature code. `conflicting_filters`: cities was combined with featureClasses or featureCodes. `feature_filter_mismatch`: featureClasses and featureCodes are both set and a code's class is not listed or a listed class has no listed code. GeoNames intersects the two lists, so those entries match nothing. `username_required`: Neither geonamesUsername nor the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME supplies a GeoNames account. `caller_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the caller-supplied geonamesUsername (unknown user, or free web services not enabled). `server_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME. `quota_exhausted`: GeoNames reported the account's hourly, daily, or weekly credit limit spent, or this server's pacer for the account shed the call. `upstream_rejected_parameter`: GeoNames rejected a value the schema let through; the message carries its text. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lat.description: The latitude that was looked up.

lng.description: The longitude that was looked up.

nearby.description: Nearest places or features, nearest first; empty when nearbyKind is none.

adminName1.description: Name of the first-order admin division containing it.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the containing country.

distanceInKm.description: Distance from the point in kilometres. Absent when GeoNames sent no usable value.

featureClass.description: One-letter feature class (P populated place, T terrain, H water, …).

featureCode.description: Feature code, such as PPL (populated place), PPLX (section), PPLH (historical place), or MT (mountain).

featureName.description: GeoNames' name for the feature code.

geonameId.description: GeoNames feature id: pass it to geonames_get_place or geonames_get_hierarchy.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Absent when GeoNames sent none.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Absent when GeoNames sent none.

name.description: Name of the place or feature, as GeoNames displays it.

population.description: Population. Absent when GeoNames records none.

toponymName.description: GeoNames' main name for the feature, often the local-language form.

nearbyKind.description: What nearby lists: populated_places, features (featureClasses or featureCodes was set), or none (nearbyLimit 0).

notice.description: Guidance when the point is offshore or unmapped, its country was matched within coastalBufferKm, nothing is nearby, nearby is full, or no IANA timezone covers it.

ocean.description: The ocean or sea at the point; present only when no country contains it or lies within coastalBufferKm.

geonameId.description: GeoNames feature id of the water body. Absent when GeoNames has none.

name.description: Name of the ocean or sea.

timezone.description: The timezone at the point; present only with includeTimezone.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the timezone country. Absent offshore.

dstOffsetInHours.description: UTC offset in hours on 1 July. Without a timezoneId the offsets are GeoNames' open-water estimate, which has no DST, so this equals rawOffsetInHours.

gmtOffsetInHours.description: UTC offset in hours on 1 January.

localTime.description: Current local time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm. Absent offshore.

rawOffsetInHours.description: Standard UTC offset in hours, without DST.

sunrise.description: Today's local sunrise, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm. Absent offshore.

sunset.description: Today's local sunset, YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm. Absent offshore.

timezoneId.description: IANA timezone id, such as Europe/Paris. Absent offshore.

truncated.description: True when nearby is full at nearbyLimit, so more may lie within the radius.

title: Reverse geocode with GeoNames
